annotations.title: Shift in question
annotations.summary: The focus moves from defining AGI to asking what can happen after AGI.
annotations.explanation: This matters because the paper studies possible paths for continued intelligence growth, not only whether AGI is possible.
annotations.boundary_notes: This does not claim ASI is guaranteed. It defines the research question.

annotations.title: Digital intelligence advantage
annotations.summary: Speed, replication, and coordination are key reasons digital systems may exceed a single human mind.
annotations.explanation: The advantage is not only higher IQ. It is also the ability to scale computation and organization.
annotations.boundary_notes: Real bottlenecks may still come from data, energy, environment interaction, and goal setting.

annotations.title: Worker as execution boundary
annotations.summary: The Worker is replaceable and should not contaminate core data contracts.
annotations.explanation: Codex is useful now because it can execute tasks. Later, a script or background service should consume the same task and result contracts.
annotations.boundary_notes: A Worker may orchestrate and validate, but should not silently rewrite paper facts or user understanding state.
